tool.name: Call Agent
tool.description: Delegate work into a child conversation. Requires that content includes agent mention token(s) like <@a:AGENT_ID>; routing inside the child conversation triggers the mentioned agent(s).

content.description: User message content. Must include at least one agent mention token like <@a:AGENT_ID>.

childConversationId.description: Optional existing child conversation id to continue in

parentConversationId.description: Optional parent conversation id. Defaults to the current conversation when available.

nodes.name: Prepare Call Request
nodes.description: Build request payload including parentConversationId when available

nodes.name: Route Mode
nodes.description: Decide whether to create a new child conversation or use existing

nodes.name: Create Child Conversation
nodes.description: POST /conversations - create a new child conversation linked to current one

nodes.name: Send Message (New Child)
nodes.description: POST /conversations/:conversationId/messages - send message into new child conversation

nodes.name: Format Result (New Child)
nodes.description: Format result for newly created child conversation

nodes.name: Update Parent Message (linkedConversationId)
nodes.description: PUT /messages/:messageId - set linkedConversationId on the calling message (thread entry point)
